heading.title: Suits by or against the government or public officers in their official capacity

article.title: Agent for Government to receive process.
article.content:
4Agent for Government to receive process.

Order 27, Rule 4
The Government pleader in any Court shall be the agent of the Government for the purpose of receiving processes against the Government issued by such Court].

6 Subs. by the A.O. 1937, for rule 4.
